## Atheist Warrior (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 Male human fighter 6  
 LN Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 22, touch 11, f lat-footed 21 (+8 armor, +1 Dex, +3 shield)  
 **hp** 78 (6d10+18)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +3, **Will** +4; +2 vs. fear  
 **Defensive Abilities** bravery +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  
 **Melee** +1 longsword with godslayer blessing +12/+7 (1d8+7/19–20) or dagger +9/+4 (1d4+3/19–20)  
 **Ranged** longbow +7/+2 (1d8/×3)  
 **Special Attacks** weapon training (heavy blades +1)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Unless under immediate threat, He takes his time to study and parley with opponents. However, he rarely gives enemy divine casters a chance to escape.  

 **During Combat** He concentrates his attacks on divine casters. Once he defeats them, he offers a truce to any surviving foes. He often pretends to be a dumb brute to mislead opponents.  

 **Morale** Knowing that if killed he does not have the luxury of a divine resurrection, he surrenders and lives rather than fighting to the death, though it galls him greatly to be humbled by a religious opponent.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 12, **Con** 15, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 20  
**Feats** Cleave, Godless Healing (see below), Persuasive, Shield Focus, Weapon Focus (longsword), Weapon Specialization (longsword), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +2, Heal +4, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (religion) +3, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** armor training 1  
**Gear** half-plate, heavy steel shield, +1 longsword with godslayer blessing, dagger, longbow with 20 arrows, 63 gp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Feat (Ex)** To compensate for their lack of divine healing, his people have developed the Godless Healing feat, a specialized technique to ignore injury. Once per day, when he is at 25 hit points or fewer, he can make a DC 10 Fortitude save as a move action to heal 1 Hit Point per level (minimum 3).
